name: Bossier Loop Phase 1
monitor_reason: length: single-origin 16 mi (25.7 km, barely over the 25 km line), no endpoints, and no second source; a 2006 loop of the RIGS 24-inch line likely already inside P0244 (200 mi, diameters 12-24 in) and P5823
researcher_notes: EIA August 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 406: Bossier Loop Phase 1, Regency Intrastate Pipeline Co, expansion, completed 2006-10-01, Louisiana, 16 miles, 24 inch, 100 MMcf/d added, intrastate. Checked P0244 (RIGS, 200 mi, Caddo to Franklin Parish) and P5823 (Regency Intrastate Enhancement Project, 120 mi, 30 and 42 inch). Neither is this loop, but P0244 lists 24 inch and likely contains it. No endpoints or independent source found. An Oil and Gas Journal article on a Regency Louisiana expansion loaded but did not name the Bossier loop. Intrastate, so no FERC filing expected; Louisiana regulator not checked. Phase 2 (row 437, 5 mi, 2007) is under the length line. Owner entity_lookup not run to a result (script takes name only).
